span.div:
For an open pull request targeting main with no prior Auto PR Triage outcome:
First application of the 'open source' label while ready for review
OR first time a pull request already carrying that label moves from draft to ready for review

div.b: Does the pull request meet repository policy?

span.div:
The pull request is linked to close an issue in the same
repository marked 'actionable'
OR the author has triage+ permission for this repository
OR a triage+ maintainer reviewed, commented,
or requested themselves

1. Codepath ownership: Match changed files to rules in
.github/auto-pr-triage/codepath_owners.txt.
2. Semantic ownership: Use an LLM and descriptions in
.github/auto-pr-triage/extra_ownership_metadata.json
to add ownership areas based on what the change does.

div.span:
Were any codepath or
semantic owners found?

span.div:
The previous step produces two types of owners:
Direct GitHub targets: @user and @org/team handles
are already reviewer targets.
Team owner IDs: Resolve each ID through its roster in
.github/auto-pr-triage/team_members.json. A roster member
already covering the pull request as a direct codepath owner,
submitted reviewer, or pending reviewer satisfies the team.
Otherwise, choose the next eligible member by round robin.

div.span:
Did ownership analysis or
reviewer resolution fail?

Are all material concerns covered
OR has an eligible roster member
already submitted a review?

Has an eligible person from a configured
team roster already submitted a review?
